description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender.
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0} due to Aang, Master of Elements.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements
